note: The /damage command does not exist before 1.19.4, so these cases are hand-derived by executing the armor formula exactly as written in the decompiled server source for 1.16.5 and 1.18.2 (mc-pipeline/work/<v>/src/), in float32. The formula is unchanged since 1.9 and identical to the RCON-measured 1.20.6+ versions, whose vectors in mc-pipeline/vectors/damage/ agree with the same math.

sources.armor: net.minecraft.world.damagesource.CombatRules#getDamageAfterAbsorb (1.16.5 and 1.18.2 trees, identical): f = clamp(armor - amount / (2 + toughness / 4), armor * 0.2, 20); damage = amount * (1 - f / 25)
sources.protection: net.minecraft.world.item.enchantment.ProtectionEnchantment#getDamageProtection (Type.ALL returns the level) and net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity#getDamageAfterMagicAbsorb via CombatRules#getDamageAfterMagicAbsorb: EPF sum clamped to 20, damage * (1 - epf / 25)

mobStats.note: Curated mob combat stats read from the decompiled trees for all six versions. Values are identical in every tree that has the mob; class names are 1.21.11 Mojang mappings. attack is the typical hit before difficulty scaling; heldItemBonus is the attack_damage modifier of the mob's held weapon, included in the attack total because Mob#doHurtTarget reads the full ATTACK_DAMAGE attribute.

mobs.source: Zombie#createAttributes: ATTACK_DAMAGE 3, ARMOR 2; MAX_HEALTH default 20 (Attributes.MAX_HEALTH RangedAttribute base)

AbstractSkeleton#performRangedAttack launch speed 1.6; AbstractArrow#onHitEntity ceil(speed x baseDamage), baseDamage 2 x power plus a difficulty-seeded random (setBaseDamageFromMob); typical point-blank hit 4
WitherSkeleton constructor setBaseValue(ATTACK_DAMAGE, 4) plus stone sword attack_damage modifier 4
Spider#createAttributes MAX_HEALTH 16; ATTACK_DAMAGE left at the Attributes.ATTACK_DAMAGE default base 2
Creeper explosionRadius 3; ExplosionDamageCalculator#getEntityDamageAmount (inline in 1.16.5 Explosion#explode): (x * x + x) / 2 * 7 * diameter + 1 = 43 at point blank (x = 1, diameter = 6)
Blaze#createAttributes ATTACK_DAMAGE 6 (melee; the small fireball is a separate 5 fire damage projectile)
Vindicator#createAttributes ATTACK_DAMAGE 5, MAX_HEALTH 24, plus iron axe attack_damage modifier 8
PiglinBrute#createAttributes ATTACK_DAMAGE 7, MAX_HEALTH 50, plus golden axe attack_damage modifier 6
IronGolem#doHurtTarget: attack / 2 + nextInt((int)attack) with ATTACK_DAMAGE 15, so 7.5 to 21.5, average 14.5
Warden#createAttributes ATTACK_DAMAGE 30, MAX_HEALTH 500; the class does not exist in the 1.16.5 or 1.18.2 trees (added in 1.19)

mobStats.classificationSource: 1.16.5 Mob#getMobType overrides; 1.21.11 data/minecraft/tags/entity_type/undead.json (skeletons + zombies + wither + phantom) and arthropod.json (spider, cave_spider, silverfish, endermite, bee), read from the server jar

difficultyCases.note: Player#hurtServer (Player#hurt in 1.16.5): peaceful 0, easy min(d / 2 + 1, d), normal unchanged, hard d * 3 / 2. Applied only to player defenders. Mob melee scales in every version (legacy EntityDamageSource#scalesWithDifficulty: attacker is a living non-player; modern damage_type/mob_attack.json when_caused_by_living_non_player). Explosions scale in every version (legacy DamageSource.explosion setScalesWithDifficulty; modern damage_type/explosion.json always). Arrows scale only from 1.20.6 on: legacy IndirectEntityDamageSource passes the arrow (not the shooter) into the EntityDamageSource entity field that scalesWithDifficulty checks.

cases.note: mob defenders never get scaled damage; scaling lives in Player#hurtServer

strikeCases.note: Player#attack composition, identical order in 1.16.5 and 1.21.11: the ATTACK_DAMAGE attribute (base + Strength 3 per level - Weakness 4 per level, floored at 0 by the attribute range 0..2048) takes the 1.5x crit multiplier; the Sharpness / Smite / Bane bonus (DamageEnchantment#getDamageBonus: 1 + 0.5 x (level - 1); 2.5 x level vs the right class) is added after the crit. Strength / Weakness values confirmed in the 1.16.5, 1.18.2, 1.20.6, and 1.21.11 MobEffects.

cases.note: fist + Weakness I floors at 0 (attribute minimum)

absorptionCases.note: LivingEntity#actuallyHurt (identical in 1.16.5 and 1.21.11): absorption points are subtracted from the post-armor post-effect damage before health, and the pool does not regenerate, so the kill threshold is hp + absorption. AbsorptionMobEffect grants 4 x (amplifier + 1) points: golden apple Absorption I = 4, enchanted golden apple Absorption IV = 16 (Foods.java in 1.16.5; the food component in modern item_components). The enchanted golden apple also grants Resistance I.

cases.note: full diamond first, then absorption soaks what is left
